usedFor: Wordpress holds posts and users, and Algodocs stores a file received by URL through “Upload Document”.

bestTemplate.name: “Post Updated” in Wordpress, then “Upload Document” in Algodocs
bestTemplate.why: Each time a post changes, a document can be filed in Algodocs without anyone doing it by hand.

watchOut: “Post Deleted” and “Post Trash” are separate triggers, so removals need their own step.
